Real Estate Virtual Assistant Support

A real estate virtual assistant supports the recurring administration behind prospecting, client communication and property workflows. Virtual Office Angels matches the role to your agency’s tasks, systems and working style, with ongoing HR, payroll, IT and team support included.

Find the Right FitSee What You Can Delegate

Role scope

Keep property administration moving while your local team stays focused on clients and listings.

The service starts with the outcomes, recurring work and systems that need coverage. The role is then defined around tasks that can be documented, reviewed and integrated into your existing team.

01

CRM upkeep

Update contact details, lead stages, property notes, activities and approved follow-up dates.

02

Lead administration

Research and organise prospect information, maintain lead lists and record outreach outcomes.

03

Approved follow-up

Complete calls or messages using agency-approved scripts, processes and escalation rules.

04

Inbox and calendar support

Sort enquiries, coordinate appointments and keep the team’s schedules current.

05

Listing administration

Prepare draft listing information, organise media or documents and track required approvals.

06

Property file coordination

Maintain checklists, supporting records and milestone updates across the agency workflow.

When this role fits

Choose specialised support when the workflow needs more than general administration.

  • Agents are spending too much selling time on CRM and inbox administration.
  • Prospect records and approved follow-ups require consistent attention.
  • Property files need clearer document and milestone tracking.
  • The agency wants an experienced remote professional with managed support.

Clear role boundaries

Support works best with defined authority and review.

The virtual assistant follows the agency’s approved scripts, authorities and escalation process. Licensed activity, negotiation, legal interpretation and decisions requiring a local or authorised professional stay with the appropriate team member.

Managed virtual support

The person, onboarding and ongoing support are managed around the role.

VOA covers the staffing relationship so your team can focus on priorities, workflows and quality. The process remains specific to the service, systems and working standards you require.
